io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.utils

Class ItemGlow

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.utils.ItemGlow

  • public final class ItemGlow
extends java.lang.Object
    Utility class to add an enchantment glint to items using the modern ItemMeta#setEnchantmentGlintOverride(Boolean) API.
